title: Retrieve-then-Disambiguate: Scalable Reviewer Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.40768v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing number of scientific submissions is straining the peer review process, while a large pool of relevant researchers remains unidentified and is therefore not considered as potential reviewers. We formulate the discovery of these researchers as a retrieval problem: given a submission, we retrieve and rank researchers based on domain similarity. We present retrieve-then-disambiguate, an open-source algorithm that identifies domain relevant researchers for a query submission by retrieving similar publications from the scientific literature and resolving ambiguous author names into unique researcher identities. We evaluate the algorithm on 500 astronomy and physics publications. We use ORCID-linked first authors, coauthors, and cited researchers as proxy labels to evaluate the recovery of researchers with known connections to each query publication. When retrieving the top 500 most similar papers, the algorithm recovers roughly 68\

translated_title: 检索-消歧：可扩展的审稿人发现
translated_abstract: 科学投稿数量的不断增长使同行评审流程承受巨大压力，而大量相关领域的研究人员仍未被识别，因此未被纳入潜在审稿人的考虑范围。我们将发现这些研究人员的问题形式化为一个检索问题：给定一篇投稿，基于领域相似度检索并排序研究人员。我们提出了“检索-消歧”，这是一种开源算法，通过从科学文献中检索相似论文，并将有歧义的作者姓名解析为唯一的研究人员身份，来为查询的投稿识别领域相关的研究人员。我们在500篇天文学和物理学论文上对该算法进行了评估，使用与ORCID关联的第一作者、合作者以及被引研究人员作为代理标签，来评估算法能否找回与每篇查询论文存在已知关联的研究人员。在检索相似度最高的前500篇论文时，该算法大约能找回68%……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出开源的“检索-消歧”算法，通过检索相似文献并将模糊作者姓名解析为唯一研究者身份，实现可扩展的潜在审稿人自动发现。
en_tdlr: An open-source retrieve-then-disambiguate algorithm that scalably identifies domain-relevant reviewers by retrieving similar publications from the scientific literature and resolving ambiguous author names into unique researcher identities.
